เรือนไทยภาคกลาง (Traditional Thai house, front view): A traditional wooden Thai house on stilts, seen frontally at eye level in bright daylight; blue sky, white clouds. The walls and steep upper gable are dark brown wood panels; the tall gable roof edges and trim are dark red, with hooked finials at the eave corners. Below the gable is a lower roof of orange terracotta tiles, and a smaller brown-tiled roof covers the entrance porch on the left. One wooden staircase with red balustrades rises from the porch to a long red-railed veranda. Three large clay jars sit on the railing. The upper wall has three window openings, two with vertical bars, and a carved double wooden door on the right. Red posts stand on pale concrete footings. Teal minivan parked at left. Trees: one leafless and one leafy tree at left, palms and trees at right. Paved road in front.
